control.rule: sparsity ratio at the trigger of the held-out windows > 1 + 3 f_trig
control.why: the concentration test counted 150-200 subcomponents switched on at the trigger; if this fails, P4 says nothing about the metric

gate.rule: every seed-0 pull-back's held-out P(target) and kl_other at step 10 within 0.01 of the ladder's curve; r2_t359 seed 0's Pile PGD ratio within 25% of 1.532 (L40). Fails: nothing below is scored (the states are not the ladder's)

measurements.blind_to: every Pile number is blind to the trigger (about 3 trigger positions in 131k); the trigger is covered by the ladder's task-local harness (not rerun) and by C1 here
measurements.floors: W0, same card, same job: f_seed = max/min - 1 over adversary seeds 0, 1, 2 (stochastic, PGD); f_block = |block0 - block1| / mean at seed 0 (CI-masked, unmasked, sparsity: deterministic under Gamma frozen); f_trig = |half A - half B| / mean of the held-out windows at W0. 'Within the floor' = ratio <= 1 + 3 f
measurements.pile: round 2's harness, val rows 0..255 in two 128-row blocks, one shared PGD adversary per block (20 steps of 0.1, seed 0), stochastic (2 draws), CI-masked and unmasked KL; each as a ratio to W0 on the same rows
measurements.sparsity: VPD's importance-minimality loss at the released run's end-of-training setting (p 0.4, beta 0.5, eps 1e-12; faithfulness.sparsity_loss) on the same rows, ratio to W0
measurements.sparsity_trigger: the same loss on the upper-leaky CI values at the trigger position of the task's held-out windows, ratio to W0

predictions.bears_on: reading A on common-word tasks (r0_t588 read PGD 1.09)
predictions.rule: each of the four KL ratios <= 1 + 3 f and PGD <= 1.5, on all three tasks

predictions.predicted: pass (expected >= 1.3: the largest off-target kl_other on the ladder)

predictions.bears_on: whether the one recorded failure is seed noise
predictions.reported: the decision's three-way rule on the 1.5 line: all above = fails reading A on this task; all below = the 1.53 was noise; split = mean and spread, no verdict. Also the state-level PGD floor (max/min - 1)

predictions.bears_on: the third VPD loss; read with C1 (blind, not broken)

predictions.arm: do-nothing vs pull-back, seed 0, five tasks
predictions.bears_on: 'Delta not absorbing delta-W' is what the pull-back buys
predictions.rule: do-nothing PGD ratio > pull-back PGD ratio on every task

states: per task, step 10 of the ladder's recipe: do-nothing (arm-A fine-tune, delta-W in Delta, released components, Gamma frozen) and the Adam pull-back on all alive (U, V) with Delta and Gamma frozen; seed = batch order
